Group rides in Nevada

6 recurring group rides around Nevada: 4 road, 1 mountain bike, 1 social. 3 roll on weeknights, 3 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Giant Las Vegas Summerlin Saturday Road Ride in Las Vegas — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Reno Wheelmen Wednesday Group Ride runs b ~18 mph, C ~15 mph, faster riders self-organize.
